newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich says hopes for US budget deal this week.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich says hopes for US budget deal this week.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said on Tuesday he hoped a budget deal could be reached with the White House this week.

"I do think it would be helpful for the president to have a budget agreement before he leaves to go out of the country, and I think that probably makes this week more useful," Gingrich told reporters. Concerns about getting the appropriations process moving was also a factor, he said.
"We hope we can get it done this week, we're for getting it done," the Georgia Republican said.
Gingrich made the comments after emerging from a meeting with Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich and Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici.
Domenici, a New Mexico Republican, said: "Things are moving along."
